run_eval_model_cli: run the eval_model script to evaluate a ParlAI model on a specified task
run_eval_model_multitask: run the eval_model script to evaluate a model across multiple comma-separated tasks
run_eval_model_save_report: run the eval_model script with a report filename to save evaluation results as JSON
create_evaluator_instance: create an Evaluator instance with an Opt object and call eval_model to evaluate
setup_eval_args: setup the evaluation argument parser with setup_args to configure metrics, logging, and task options
